summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Habib Networks broadband app. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed (auth OTP, /me, plans + filters, offers, plan change, mock UPI recharge, recharge history, complaints CRUD, customer-care). Frontend: end-to-end flows verified on mobile viewport (390x844) — OTP login (9876543210/1234) -> Home with active plan + data ring + quick actions + offer -> Recharge (GPay -> Pay Now -> Success -> Back to Home) -> Plans tab with Monthly/6-Months/Yearly filters -> Complaints tab with Active/Resolved chips and new complaint via FAB (TKT- created) -> Account tab -> Customer Care -> in-app call mock -> end call. No React Native red screens or crashes observed. Minor console warnings only: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), pointerEvents prop deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), and useNativeDriver missing on web (expected on web preview).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' RN Web style props emit console warnings. Use style.boxShadow or theme.shadow via a web-compatible mapping. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/theme.ts + usages in recharge.tsx, account.tsx, complaints.tsx, index.tsx, PlanCard.tsx, Toast.tsx
props.pointerEvents is deprecated on React Native Web. Move pointerEvents into style. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Toast.tsx:53

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate shadow* style props to style.boxShadow across theme + affected screens to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional/cosmetic) Move pointerEvents prop into style in Toast.tsx.
No functional fixes required. App is ready for demo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py excludes MongoDB _id via projection everywhere — good.
Auth uses Bearer <phone> as token — acknowledged as intentional mock; not for production.
All endpoints use /api prefix and env-based Mongo URL — compliant with platform rules.
All interactive elements have testID attributes — good testability.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 plans + 4 offers on startup; on first verify-otp per phone, a demo user + 2 sample complaints are seeded. Test used a random 10-digit phone plus 9876543210 for UI. No manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bearer token is the raw phone number. Use OTP 1234. Bottom tabs render as <a href='/plans'|/complaints|/account'> in web preview; clicking the text label via get_by_text can be flaky — prefer direct page.goto to /plans, /complaints, /account for e2e web tests, or click via a[href='/complaints']. Recharge flow: quick-action-recharge goes directly to /recharge (active plan pre-filled); plans tab -> select-plan-<id> also routes to /recharge with that plan.
